classification.difficultyReason: Read each named angle's vertex, identify the hypotenuse from the right-angle mark, and assign opposite and adjacent; changing the reference angle directly swaps the two legs.

content.prompt: For the triangle opposite, name the opposite side, the adjacent side and the hypotenuse, using:

spec.description: Right triangle PQR with P above R and Q to the right of R; ordinary source blue strokes become black under house style.
spec.mathematics: Right angle at R; no numerical lengths supplied.
spec.answerVisibility: All supplied geometry visible; side classifications absent.

answer.worked: $PQ$ is opposite the right angle at $R$, so it is the hypotenuse. Relative to the angle at $Q$, $PR$ is opposite and $QR$ is adjacent.
